constraints: If rangeObj contains multiple ranges, only the first range is used to determine the starting cell.
formulasCol is two-dimensional: the first-level collection holds one subcollection per row, and each subcollection element is a formula (Text) assigned to successive cells in that row.
If formula is a string, use the period (.) as numerical separator and the comma (,) as parameter separator.
If a formula references a 4D method, that method must first be allowed with VP SET ALLOWED METHODS.
Remove a formula from a cell by passing an empty string ("") for it in formulasCol.
